author: GodEmperorDoge
name: Watch
short: Preload a movie or episodes so they stream fast.
description: Ask the home lab's media-preload service to cache a movie, a season, some episodes, or your next unwatched episodes, and follow the download in the channel.
install_msg: Set the API token with the PRELOAD_BOT_TOKEN environment variable or `[p]set api media_preload token,<token>` (and url,<url> if it isn't http://host.containers.internal:8125).
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the Jellyfin user name you link with `watch link`, to find your next unwatched episodes. `watch unlink` deletes it.
